questions.q: What four things should storefront's root README cover, in order?
options: Install Node, install Python, install Docker, install kubectl
What this is, how to run it locally, how it's deployed, where to look next
Architecture diagram, API reference, FAQ, contact info
License, contributors, changelog, roadmap
questions.explain: The guide specifies the README should answer what the project is, how to run it locally, how it's deployed, and where to find further documentation, in that order.

questions.q: Which artifact from Lesson 16 gets checked into docs/ as part of this lesson?
options: The k6 load-testing script only
The original undersized connection pool configuration
A screenshot of the Alertmanager UI
The postmortem write-up for the flash-sale incident
questions.explain: docs/postmortems/ holds the Lesson 16 postmortem write-up, checked into Git alongside the runbooks and architecture diagram.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the inventory-pool-saturation.md runbook?
options: To turn the 12-minute live trace-discovery incident into a quick, known-first-check next time
To document PaymentPro's API rate limits
To list every Terraform resource in the dev environment
To replace the postmortem document entirely
questions.explain: The guide calls this runbook the most important artifact from the chapter because it converts future trace-discovery time into a fast, known lookup.

questions.q: In the recommended demo script, what happens right after a tag is cut?
options: The repository is archived
A new feature branch is created automatically
Staging deploys automatically, then a manual approval gate guards the prod deploy
The image is immediately pushed to prod with no checks
questions.explain: Per the branching plan, a tag triggers an automatic staging deploy, and prod requires a manual approval gate (GitHub Environments protection rule) before deploying.

questions.q: According to this lesson, how does the capstone's incident drill connect to Chapter 6?
options: It doesn't — Chapter 6 covers unrelated material
It is deleted before the capstone is presented to employers
It becomes the concrete story used to answer behavioral and incident interview questions
It is replaced by a hypothetical incident for interviews
questions.explain: The guide states the incident drill becomes the real story told in response to behavioral and incident interview questions in Chapter 6.
